summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Dotindot Phase 1 (Clients & Projects). All critical flows verified: JWT auth for 5 roles, quick-login buttons, RBAC (employee 403s on clients/users/logs/projects-write; credential reveal admin/pm only), seed data (10 clients, 15 projects, idempotent), Clients list with charts + filters + search, Client detail tabs (Contracts expiry flag 'Expires in 18d' verified for Skyline Realty, Credentials masked + reveal shows decrypted 'Sk!Line#wp2026'), 5-step Create Project wizard submits successfully end-to-end, project appears in list + assigned employee's My Projects, employee sidebar correctly restricted to Dashboard + Projects only, User Management CRUD + deactivation, global central search dropdown with 3 results for 'sky', activity logs, openapi 200. 24/24 backend pytest cases pass.

issues: Recharts console warning: 'width(-1) height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' fires on initial render before ResponsiveContainer measures parent. Charts render fine afterwards but warnings clutter console; consider setting a min-height on the chart container to suppress.

action_items: Optional: suppress Recharts width/height=-1 console warnings by giving chart wrappers explicit min-height (design polish only, not a bug).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_projects toggle endpoint uses body schema {kind, item_id} (not deliverable_id) - well designed, supports both milestones and deliverables under a single endpoint.
routes_users PUT (not PATCH) used for role/is_active updates - consistent with rest of API.
Credential reveal endpoint properly restricted at both API (admin/pm) and UI level; secret only fetched on-demand.
Seed uses $setOnInsert - verified idempotent (counts stay at 10/15 across restarts).
Employee project scoping enforced server-side (employee GET /api/projects returns only assigned 11 of 15) — good.
All key interactive elements carry data-testid attributes — makes automated regression easy.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test users via UI/API (TestUser test_XXXXX@dotindot.test - one active, one deactivated). Created 1 test project 'TEST_PlaywrightProj' via wizard flow (project id 2b8e40ff...). Did not touch any seeded records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has 24 cases across auth/RBAC/seed/CRUD/toggle/user-management/logs. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Note: toggle body needs {kind:'deliverable'|'milestone', item_id: ...}. Users update uses PUT not PATCH. Deactivating seeded users will break login tests — create fresh users for deactivation testing.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Phase 1 implementation is solid across auth, RBAC, seed idempotency, CRUD, wizard, tab navigation, central search, credential masking/reveal, and role-based UI gating.
